data.spec: Local photo-informed approximate 3D cutaway, self-contained OfficeTwin.tsx/officeScene.ts/office-twin.css plus twin device editor files. Physical demo button rendered on stage in front of burgundy chairs at scene(-5.65,6.7), defaults to station_id:kitchen. Hardware bridge --station kitchen and existing POST /api/device-events update the same authoritative station request state; no device identity/connection inferred. Users may add/name/map/reposition 3D buttons and simulated level sensors; browser-only layout config persists in localStorage, not hardware firmware. Sensor levels remain explicitly simulated until telemetry is available. No API/shared schema changes. Existing approval fingerprint/event paths retained. Keep UI component separate for agent-interface-design merge.
